title: GitHub Token Type Confusion -- Exfiltration of Non-PAT Token Variants (T1552)
author: WRG-11
description:
Detects exfiltration or exposure of GitHub OAuth (gho_), User-to-server (ghu_), Server-to-server (ghs_), and Refresh (ghr_) tokens. Scanners checking only ghs_/ghp_ (classic PAT) miss these variants.
Attack chain:
(1) Attacker crafts malicious PR or CI workflow that exfils a GitHub OAuth/user-to-server/server-to-server/refresh token via environment variable echo, CommandLine argument, or process spawn.
(2) PR-time secret scanner (devguard, gitleaks, trufflehog) inspects changed files for token patterns. Many implementations check only the classic PAT prefix (ghp_) and fine-grained PAT (ghs_), missing the OAuth (gho_), user-to-server (ghu_), server-to-server (ghs_), and refresh (ghr_) variants documented at docs.github.com/en/apps/creating-github-apps/authenticating-with-a-github-app.
(3) Scanner returns clean; PR merges; CI step echoes the token (e.g., for debugging, in environment dump, or as part of Megalodon-style base64-encoded payload). Token is captured by the attacker via log scraping, public CI output, or downstream exfiltration channel.
(4) Attacker uses the variant token for downstream actions matching its scope (OAuth: user-impersonating API calls; server-to-server: long-lived GitHub App actions; refresh: token regeneration without re-auth). Net effect = full Megalodon-style CI/CD secret exfil at scale.
Detection logic targets process_creation events where CommandLine contains any of the 4 non-PAT-classic token prefixes (gho_, ghu_, ghs_, ghr_) followed by the standard 36+ character base62 body. Sister to observed_s1ngularity_nx_npm_token_exfil_t1195_002.yml (npm token form) and observed_clawhavoc_claude_skills_t1195_002.yml (broad credential sweep). This rule fills the non-classic-PAT token-prefix coverage gap: secret scanners matching only ghp_/ghs_ miss the gho_/ghu_/ghr_ variants.
